items.summary: Update the shipped 18-hole Callaway grid defaults to match the user-provided 13-row table (row number followed by five (grossScore, worstHoles) pairs). Store these values in frontend/src/lib/callaway/callawayChartPersistence.ts within getDefault18GridChart() so a fresh install (no localStorage) uses the new grid.

Ensure existing localStorage migration/reset behavior correctly picks up the new shipped 18-hole defaults for users who still have older shipped defaults cached in localStorage (i.e., remove old shipped defaults so the updated shipped defaults are used when appropriate).
Align backend Callaway chart logic with the updated 18-hole chart behavior so backend calculations (backend/main.mo) are consistent with the 18-hole grid defaults used by the frontend for scoring.
Use English for all user-facing UI strings involved in chart editing, validation, save/reset messaging, and any new messaging introduced by these changes.
